adapters.name: calculateBaseScore
sourceBlocks: premiumScore through overall, excluding benefit/pharmacy helper calls and unused plan-classification locals
adapters.notes: Original numeric scoring statements retained inside a new parameterized wrapper. Drug, provider, benefit and pharmacy helpers are published separately; already-computed signals enter this wrapper. Original environment-based bonus settings remain in use.

standaloneAdapters.changes: Replaces @sentry/node breadcrumb collection with a no-op. Existing calculation and normalization call sites are retained; nothing is collected or sent.

New CLI that reads a supplied local CSV file and writes JSON to stdout. No downloads or database operations.
